# Pretty Nails

> Nail salon & nail art based in Georgetown, Texas. Manicures, pedicures, acrylic and gel sets, and hand-painted nail art on W University Ave. A clean, friendly salon where regulars have been coming back for years, and walk-ins are welcome.

- Phone: (512) 868-0850
- Based in: Georgetown, TX
- Nearby areas: Georgetown, Round Rock, Hutto, Jarrell, Liberty Hill, Leander
- Google rating: 4.3 from 129 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pretty-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/pretty-nails/book.html

## Services
- Manicures: Shaped, tidy and polished, with a color from the floor-to-ceiling polish wall.
- Pedicures: A relaxing pedicure in the massage chairs, with a light massage and a hot towel wrap. Bring your mom along.
- Acrylic full sets: Coffin, almond and stiletto sets shaped the way you like them, built to last.
- Gel manicures: Glossy gel color, from soft nudes to magenta glitter.
- Hand-painted nail art: Show a photo of the design you want and the team paints it by hand.
- French tips: Classic white, or a colored French in navy, hot pink or neon green.

## About
Pretty Nails is a neighborhood nail salon at 950 W University Ave, Suite 206, in Georgetown, open six days a week. Inside it's golden walls, a burgundy chair rail, a full wall of polish and a row of massage pedicure chairs under amber pendant lights. Many clients have been coming for five or six years and bring their mothers, mothers-in-law and friends. One regular, who had her nails done in San Francisco for 25 years, calls it the very best in Georgetown. Another drives in from out of town just to see Cassandra.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Where is Pretty Nails?
  A: 950 W University Ave, Suite 206, Georgetown, TX 78626, on University Ave near Southwestern University.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. On busy days a quick call to (512) 868-0850 helps save your spot.
- Q: How long does a pedicure take?
  A: About half an hour, with a soak, a light massage and a hot towel wrap. Easy to fit into a lunch break.
- Q: Can you paint a design from a photo?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo of the look you want, from holiday trees and snowflakes to star foil, swirls and yin-yangs, and the team will paint it by hand.
- Q: Can I request a specific nail tech?
  A: Yes. Many regulars ask for Linda, Mimi, Tommy or Cassandra by name. Just mention who you'd like when you call.
- Q: Can I bring a friend or family member?
  A: Of course. Mothers, daughters and friends often come in together for pedicures and sets.
